title: {NiIILnIII} (Ln = Gd, Dy) rod-like nano-sized heteronuclear coordination clusters with a double carbonate bridge skeleton and remarkable MCE behaviour

material_class.structural_family: rod-like Ni8Ln6 cluster with double carbonate-bridged octanuclear {Ni4Ln4} core and {NiLn} cubane caps

synthesis.procedure: The nickel pivalate precursor (100 mg, 0.1 mmol) was dissolved in 5 mL MeCN. Triethanolamine (41 mg, 0.28 mmol) and triethylamine (128 mg, 1.3 mmol) in 5 mL MeCN were added; a pale solid formed and was redissolved with a few drops of methanol under stirring. Gd(NO3)3·xH2O (76 mg, ~0.15 mmol) in 5 mL methanol was added. The mixture was stirred for 1 h under aerobic conditions, filtered, and allowed to evaporate slowly at room temperature. Very pale green plates of 1 crystallized within 1–3 weeks.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution reaction under aerobic/open atmosphere; filtration and slow evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered and allowed to stand for slow evaporation at room temperature; pale green plates
synthesis.yield: average 10%, ca. 10 mg, based on Ni

properties.summary: DC susceptibility and magnetization of 1 indicate competing Ni–Ni and ferromagnetic Ni–Gd interactions, a high-spin ground state near S ≈ 25 with low-lying excited multiplets, and a field-switchable magnetocaloric effect. Maximum −ΔSm is 12.6 J kg−1 K−1 at 8.5 K for a 0–7 T field change, below the isolated-ion limit but above an isolated S = 22–25 ground-state estimate.

measurements.name: magnetization
measurements.conditions: lowest T in 1.8–10 K, 0–70 kOe; incipient saturation

measurements.name: magnetic entropy change ΔSm
measurements.conditions: maximum at 8.5 K for 0–7 T field change

synthesis.procedure: Prepared analogously to 1: nickel pivalate precursor (100 mg, 0.1 mmol) in 5 mL MeCN treated with triethanolamine (41 mg, 0.28 mmol) and triethylamine (128 mg, 1.3 mmol) in 5 mL MeCN; pale solid redissolved with methanol drops. Dy(NO3)3·xH2O (76 mg, ~0.15 mmol) in 5 mL methanol was added. Stirred 1 h, filtered, and crystallized by slow evaporation at room temperature over 1–3 weeks as very pale green plates.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution reaction under aerobic/open atmosphere; filtration and slow evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered and allowed to stand for slow evaporation at room temperature; pale green plates
synthesis.yield: average 10%, ca. 10 mg, based on Ni

properties.summary: Room-temperature χmT is 95.5 cm3 K mol−1. Magnetization does not saturate and increases with temperature at fixed field, indicating low-lying excited states. No slow magnetic relaxation was detected by AC susceptibility even under a small DC field. MCE of 2 is smaller than for the Gd analogue at low T, with a shifted ΔSm maximum (>5 K) and a sign reversal of entropy change at the highest field and lowest temperature, attributed to Dy anisotropy and weak Ni–Dy exchange.
